versions.text: (a) Each landing gear wheel must have a tyre: (1) That is a proper fit on the rim of the wheel; and (2) Of the proper rating. (b) The maximum static load rating of each tyre must equal or exceed the static ground reaction obtained at its wheel, assuming: (1) The design maximum weight; and (2) The most unfavourable centre of gravity. (c) Each tyre installed on a retractable landing gear system must, at the maximum size of the tyre type expected in service, have a clearance to surrounding structure and systems that is adequate to prevent contact between the tyre and any part of the structure or systems.
